withdraw.missing: An observable class or attribute that carries what DEF-NRS-484A-030 makes a bus: a vehicle 'owned by the State, a political subdivision or a private school or nursery, designed for carrying more than 10 passengers and used for the transportation of persons', or a vehicle 'other than a taxicab, designed and used for the transportation of persons for compensation'. Without it the run's reading cannot include any road-user class under DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus. It now records 'included (none)', with ru.bus, ru.transit_bus, ru.school_bus and ru.tour_bus_or_limousine all unresolved. So the subject's binder class (c1) is never decided true, and the duty is reported only as not_applicable or unknown, never compliant or violated. The exception span c2 (DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::tour_bus) has the same defect. That definition covers a motor vehicle 'other than a limousine ... designed, maintained and used to transport more than six persons ... to or from hotels, motels, casinos, cultural or athletic events or other tourist attractions'. No class atom carries that service apart from limousines, so the reading leaves every class unresolved and no bus is decidedly not a tour bus. The gap decides which road users the duty concerns. Mapping c1 and c2 to ru.bus or ru.transit_bus instead would expand an admitted aggregate into a class list, which rule 4 and the ru.aggregate contract forbid. The operator may instead review the run's reading: whether ru.transit_bus and ru.school_bus are included under DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus ('owned by ... a political subdivision', 'used for the transportation of persons for compensation'), and whether ru.transit_bus is excluded or covered under DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::tour_bus. The record is otherwise faithful. The coder's rule and witnesses (forbid, permit, idle, blind, branch_1, branch_2) are expected to pass once these classes are decided.
nearest: ru.aggregate: 'true when the user carries an included class, unknown when no included class holds and the user carries an unresolved class' — with no included class under DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus, membership is never true

ru.bus: 'motor vehicle designed to carry many passengers' — says nothing of the definition's more-than-10 design capacity, its owners (State, political subdivision, private school or nursery) or use for compensation, and the ru.aggregate contract excludes it as a stand-in for an admitted aggregate
ru.transit_bus: 'bus in public transit service, identifiable by its livery or route display' — the run's reading leaves it unresolved under both DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus and DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::tour_bus
ru.tour_bus_or_limousine: 'a tour or shuttle bus, or a lengthened passenger vehicle for hire' — it includes limousines, which DEF-LVMC-11-02-150 leaves out ('other than a limousine')
ru.occupant_count: 'the number of persons in or on a vehicle' — a count of persons present, not the number of passengers the vehicle is designed to carry
